_meta.source: Route structures from MOE post secondary admissions pages, polytechnic and ITE course listings, SkillsFuture work study programme information
_meta.notes: Futures are stated as wants, not job titles. Gottfredson's work on circumscription shows teenagers rule out whole fields early on perceived prestige and fit, before knowing anything about them. Naming a job invites that. Naming a want does not. Every future carries at least three structurally different roads, in no order, because the absence of a ranking is the content.

futures.want: I want to make things people use
futures.looksLike: Products, buildings, software, furniture, food, clothes.

routes.label: Poly first
routes.note: Making things from semester one. A portfolio before you are twenty.

routes.label: ITE first
routes.note: Fastest route to real skill with your hands.

routes.label: JC first
routes.note: Longest run up, widest theory when you arrive.

routes.label: Arts route
routes.note: Entry turns on what you made, not a score.

thisTerm: Make one thing this month nobody asked for.
Find out if your school runs Design and Tech.
Ask an Art teacher what a portfolio looks like.

futures.want: I want to be really good with my hands
futures.looksLike: Aircraft, cars, wiring, kitchens, hair, machines, buildings.

routes.label: ITE, direct
routes.note: Trained on the equipment the industry actually uses.

routes.label: ITE, then further
routes.note: GPA 2.5 to apply, guaranteed a place at 3.5.

routes.label: Poly engineering
routes.note: More theory alongside, wider first job market.

routes.label: Work study
routes.note: Paid from day one, qualified at the end.

thisTerm: Go to an ITE or poly open house.
Ask someone doing it what the bad days are.
Fix something at home that is broken.

futures.want: I want to be there when people are struggling
futures.looksLike: Nursing, social work, teaching, paramedics, early childhood.

routes.label: Poly health
routes.note: Real patients and families well before you graduate.

routes.label: ITE first
routes.note: Care employers hire from ITE and back your upgrading.

routes.label: JC, then a degree
routes.note: The route into professions that need a degree to start.

routes.label: Later, second career
routes.note: Many arrive in their thirties and bring more with them.

thisTerm: Volunteer somewhere that is not comfortable.
Ask a nurse or teacher what nobody told them.
Notice if you still care in week three.

futures.want: I want to run my own thing
futures.looksLike: A shop, studio, service, stall or practice with your name on it.

routes.label: Learn the trade
routes.note: Almost everyone learns it inside someone else's first.

routes.label: Business route
routes.note: Knowing how money moves is the whole difference.

routes.label: Degree route
routes.note: Slower to the line, wider network at it.

routes.label: Start now, small
routes.note: The only road here that needs nobody's permission.

thisTerm: Sell one thing to one person you are not related to.
Work out what it cost and if you made money.
Find out if your school offers Accounts.

futures.want: I want to work out how things work
futures.looksLike: Research, data, software, labs, engineering, medicine.

routes.label: JC, then research
routes.note: Most direct route in, and it asks most of your G3 subjects.

routes.label: Poly applied science
routes.note: In a real lab in year one, not year four.

routes.label: Computing
routes.note: The one field where what you built counts nearly as much.

routes.label: ITE, then up
routes.note: Longer, and people complete it every year.

thisTerm: Pick one thing you use daily and find out how it works.
Build or break something and write down why.
Ask a science teacher what they would study again.

futures.want: I want to be where decisions get made
futures.looksLike: Policy, law, management, public service, journalism.

routes.label: Humanities
routes.note: These teach you to argue from evidence that disagrees.

routes.label: Poly, then degree
routes.note: You arrive with experience others do not have.

routes.label: Through the work
routes.note: Many who run things took the job nobody wanted.

routes.label: Later, on purpose
routes.note: SkillsFuture Level Up exists for exactly this move.

thisTerm: Argue a position in front of people who disagree.
Read one story, then find who reported it differently.
Volunteer for the committee, not the audience.

futures.want: I honestly do not know yet
futures.looksLike: Most people your age, including the ones who sound certain.

routes.label: Keep it wide
routes.note: Not the same as everything at G3. Drowning closes more than it opens.

routes.label: Go and try things
routes.note: You cannot choose between options you have never seen.

routes.label: Pick a direction
routes.note: You can decide two years without deciding forty.

thisTerm: Go to one open house for a route you dismissed.
Ask three adults what they do all day, not their title.
Write down when you last lost track of time.
